column1: # symbol_sizes.tsv — machine-code sizes of load-bearing hot-path symbols,
# pinned per target triple. Guarded by tests/symbol_canary.rs (default
# features): each symbol's current size must be within +/-20% of its pin —
# a laptop-visible tripwire for accidental inlining/outlining flips, which
# trigger the layout lottery that erodes wall cells on the frozen boxes.
# The +/-20% band is a first guess; tune it with experience.
# Sizes are successive `nm -n` address deltas over the release-syms build
# builds across different target dirs measured byte-identical). The shipped
# stripped binary's exact layout differs slightly (-C strip reseeds fat-LTO
# layout; measured same function count, ~10% of boundaries shifted by tens
# of bytes), so these pins track the deterministic sibling — an inlining
# flip moves both together. See tests/symbol_canary.rs module doc.
# Rows exist only for triples pinned on their own box; other triples SKIP.
# x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu rows should be generated on the trainer box with
# the same command. Regenerate for the current triple (others preserved):
